examples.title: Color picker with alpha
examples.description: Alpha slider enabled: emits an 8-character hex value. The footer row shows the full #rrggbbaa string.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ColorPicker } from '@lostgradient/cinder/color-picker';

  const swatches = ['#ef444480', '#22c55e80', '#3b82f680'];
</script>

<ColorPicker value="#3b82f680" label="Color with opacity" alpha {swatches} />

examples.title: Basic color picker
examples.description: A color picker with preset swatches where the selected swatch shows a persistent check indicator without looking keyboard-focused.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ColorPicker } from '@lostgradient/cinder/color-picker';

  const swatches = ['#ef4444', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', '#f59e0b'];
</script>

<ColorPicker value="#22c55e" label="Accent color" {swatches} />

examples.title: Color picker without swatches
examples.description: Omitting the swatches prop renders only the gradient, sliders, and footer row — useful when a freeform pick without preset guidance is needed.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ColorPicker } from '@lostgradient/cinder/color-picker';
</script>

<ColorPicker value="#6366f1" label="Custom color" />

examples.title: Output format
examples.description: The format prop controls the emitted string syntax (hex, rgb, hsl, hwb, or oklch) for the bindable value.
